metadata.description: One agent skill: animate a 2D game hero from one painting.

plugins.name: spine-hero
plugins.description: Animate a 2D game hero from one painting on a Spine-style skeleton: parts cut from the painting, moves written as code by a strong model, a scripted gate, an independent defect check, a reference video for timing, an image model for hidden parts and gear, and the human eye as the final judge.
